Sunday No-Drop Ride (Incycle Pasadena)

Pasadena, CA · Road

Sunday No-Drop Ride (Incycle Pasadena) is a road group ride in Pasadena, CA. It rolls every Sunday at 7:30 am from Incycle Pasadena shop parking lot.

For visitors

The shop's Strava club description is the only listing found: the club has no dated ride posts, so check with the shop before a first visit. The group follows all traffic laws and gives pedestrians the right of way.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: group 1: intermediate, 35-45 miles, a true no-drop ride. Group 2: for riders who like a challenge, with a lot of climbing and plenty of regrouping. No sprinting or breaking away. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sunday No-Drop Ride (Incycle Pasadena) group ride

A Sunday-morning shop ride that rolls from the Incycle Pasadena parking lot at 7:30 am. The club calls it a no-drop ride for everyone. The first group is for intermediate riders who want 35 to 45 miles; the second is for riders who like climbing, with a lot of climbing and plenty of regrouping.
